title: What's New: Fixed Assets (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Demo - depreciation calculation with and without bonus

features.name: Bonus depreciation method
features.description: A new accelerated depreciation method that allows businesses to deduct a specific percentage of asset cost in the first year of service, with the remainder following regular depreciation rules. Available globally in the base app.
caveats: Different names across countries (investment bonus depreciation in Australia and New Zealand, 168K depreciation in United States, etc.)
Percentage and eligibility determined by local tax law

features.name: Fixed Asset Setup fields for bonus depreciation
features.description: Two new fields added to the Fixed Asset Setup page: percentage field for the bonus depreciation rate and effective date field that determines eligibility for all assets placed in service after that date.
caveats: Fields contain maximum percentages defined by law; lower percentages can be used
Eligibility driven by depreciation starting date of the asset

features.name: Bonus depreciation toggle on fixed asset card
features.description: A toggle field on the fixed asset depreciation book that allows users to opt in or opt out of using bonus depreciation for each individual asset, regardless of setup settings.
caveats: Automatically set to true when depreciation starting date is higher than effective date on setup, but can be manually toggled

features.name: Additional reporting fields for FA depreciation books
features.description: Several new fields have been added to the FA Depreciation Books page for reporting purposes. These fields are hidden by default but can be customized onto the page and used for reporting via Excel export.
caveats: Fields are hidden by default and require personalization to display
